Chip Industry Technical Paper Roundup: Sept. 8

Shares

HBF for LLM inference; M3D SRAM with BEOL pass-gates at 2nm; distributed GPU architectures; hybrid HBM-HBF memory; GaN-on-silicon polarization superjunctions; programmable silicon photonics; Al dopant activation in 4H-SiC.

September 8th, 2026 -

By: Linda Christensen

New technical papers recently added to Semiconductor Engineering’s library:
